neighbours.label: The burdensome work or habit that someone has to get through or be rid of: 'hard work has been done', 'bad spending habits', 'finish all your homework'
fire: Most of the hard work on the barn has been done by the neighbours.
Now is a good time to drop your bad spending habits and save.
He stayed up to finish all his homework before the game.
Try to kick the poor sleeping habits you picked up in college.
All the heavy digging in the yard has been done for us.
The trick is to fix your lazy eating habits this winter.
She promised to finish her homework after dinner.
The tough part of the move was already done by Friday.

predictions: Likely fails on median fire or AUROC.
notes: A low-confidence reading of a varied pole with no dominant token. Probes: ' habits' 0.07-0.57, ' done' 0.25-0.43, ' homework' 0.26.
